body.name: Hypertrophy/Strength 4day
body.description: Effort: Heavy lifts (machine chest press, single-leg RDL, split squats) leave 2 reps in reserve, last set 1 RIR. Machine/cable hypertrophy work 1-2 RIR; only the final set of safe exercises (leg ext, curls, pulldowns, laterals, pushdowns) to 0 RIR. Never go to failure on single-leg RDLs or split squats. Rest: strength days 2-3 min; hypertrophy days 90s-2 min on compounds, 60-90s on isolation. Progression: double progression; when you hit the top of the rep range on all sets at target RIR, add the smallest weight jump. Week 1: use weights that feel like 3 RIR to learn the machines. Deload every 5-6 weeks with about half the sets. Cable laterals and pushdowns assume the multi-gym has low and high pulleys. Optional conditioning: rower intervals after Day 1, steady rower 15 min after Day 3. Posture: chin tucks 10 slow reps 2x/day; desk screen top at eye level; stand up every 30-45 min.
